name: CROSS_WIND_YELLOW_DIAMOND
notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Diamond 750 side, drawn in its 1060.66 bounding square (centre 530.33); yellow, R50, 10 / 30 (edge 10 + border 20). W5-SA101B illustrated (A 600, C 900; PNG W5-SA101A.png). Lines centred on the vertical centre line unless noted; the sheet dimensions the legend from the centre lines — vertical positions here are the sheet's (checked against the ink at 1200 dpi): CROSS 140 D, baseline +4 from the horizontal centre line (top 394), ink 567 (measured 567, centred); WIND 140 D, baseline +216 from the horizontal centre line (top 606), ink 426 (measured 426, x 322-748).
